default.text: Oh! Don't move. No, you're fine, it's only a scratch. Sorry. Habit. I'm Fen; I patch the other three.

healer.text: Herbs, needle, bandage. No miracles; the Church keeps those. If you bleed, eat and rest. If you bleed a lot, drink one of Wren's reds, then eat and rest.

wren.text: On credit. She writes it in a little book and never adds it up while I'm looking. I'll pay her when we make rank E.

options.text: A debt's a debt. Pay it early.
Credit is how they get you.

wren_kind.text: She is. Don't tell her I said so. She'd double the price out of shame.

wren_plain.text: I know. I keep my own book, too. Mine is added up.

wren_hard.text: Not Wren. You haven't been here long.
